categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the design, manufacturing, and sales of MEMS sensors, including MEMS acoustic sensors, MEMS pressure sensors, and MEMS inertial sensors. It also provides related technical consulting and services. The business focuses on consumer electronics, automotive, industrial control, medical, and emerging fields such as robotics and IoT.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes MEMS microfabrication technology integrating chip design, wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing. Key technologies include CMOS-MEMS integration, SENSA epitaxial layer process, ASIC chip design for signal processing, wafer-level chip-scale packaging, and proprietary batch testing systems. The company also develops multi-axis force sensors, microfluidic chips, optical MEMS, and piezoelectric ultrasonic transducers (PMUT).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major consumer electronics brands including Huawei, Xiaomi, Samsung, OPPO, Lenovo, and medical device companies like Joyoung Medical and LeXin Medical. The products serve markets such as smartphones, tablets, laptops, wearable devices, smart home, automotive electronics, industrial control, medical devices, and emerging sectors like robotics and smart cities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with sales primarily in domestic markets but also expanding overseas. Manufacturing and R&D facilities are located in Suzhou, Shanghai, and Kunshan within China. The company is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange Sci-Tech Innovation Board.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the MEMS sensor supply chain, covering chip design, wafer fabrication (outsourced to foundries like SMIC), packaging, and testing. It also engages in upstream R&D and downstream module/system integration for automotive and industrial applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding MEMS sensor product lines, enhancing core technologies, and accelerating industrialization of new products such as multi-axis force sensors, microfluidic chips, MEMS lidar components, and PMUT devices. The company emphasizes innovation in miniaturization, low power consumption, multi-sensor integration, and intelligent sensing aligned with AI and IoT trends. It invests heavily in R&D, maintaining over 20% of revenue in R&D with a strong patent portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of MEMS sensors and related modules. The company uses a mixed sales model with distribution as the primary channel and direct sales as a supplement. It also earns income from technical consulting and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among the leading domestic MEMS sensor manufacturers in China, ranking globally in the top 5 for MEMS microphones and top 40 for MEMS design and manufacturing. Competitors include international giants like Bosch, Infineon, STMicroelectronics, and domestic emerging MEMS firms. The company leverages its local manufacturing and R&D capabilities to compete on cost and customization.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 372 million, a 27.3% increase year-over-year, driven by increased sales volume and new product adoption. However, it recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 101.8 million, reflecting industry price pressures and increased operating costs. Total assets reached RMB 1.23 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.07 billion, showing moderate growth. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive in-house capabilities across MEMS chip design, wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing, enabling high-performance, miniaturized, and cost-effective MEMS sensors. Its products feature advanced technologies such as high signal-to-noise ratio, low power consumption, and multi-axis sensing. The company also focuses on rapid innovation cycles, customization for key customers, and integration into emerging applications like robotics and automotive, providing differentiated solutions tailored to evolving market needs.
